config.label: LibreLinkUp *follower* account e-mail — not the primary LibreLink account
config.description: LibreLinkUp *follower* account e-mail — not the primary LibreLink account. The password is stored once via `npx mcp-freestyle-login` in the OS keychain, so it never appears in this configuration.

config.label: Overrides the OS keychain
config.description: Overrides the OS keychain. Intended for CI and one-off runs; prefer `mcp-freestyle-login` so no credential lands in a config file.

config.label: Pinned LibreLinkUp client version sent as the `version` header
config.description: Pinned LibreLinkUp client version sent as the `version` header. Upstream rejects stale values — set this to the current LibreLinkUp app version if requests start failing.

config.label: Client product identifier sent as the `product` header
config.description: Client product identifier sent as the `product` header.

config.label: Entry point for authentication
config.description: Entry point for authentication. The regional host is discovered at login and is never configured here.
